# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

This project is a small technical repository, and the expectation is simple: engage with the work, not with the person.

Concretely, that means welcoming questions of any level, giving and accepting critique about code and reasoning, stating disagreement with what a change does rather than with who proposed it, and correcting a mistake once it is shown.

Unacceptable behaviour includes harassment of any kind, personal or demeaning remarks, sexualised language or attention, publishing another person's private information without permission, and sustained disruption of discussion.

These standards follow the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/); the enforcement section below is specific to this repository.

## Scope

This applies in every space this project owns: issues, pull requests, discussions, commit messages, and code review. It also applies when someone represents the project elsewhere.

## Enforcement

The maintainer is responsible for enforcement and may edit, hide, or delete contributions that breach this standard, and may block accounts that continue to.

Report a concern to the maintainer through GitHub at [hawkxdev](https://github.com/hawkxdev). If the concern involves the maintainer, or you would rather not make contact directly, use [GitHub's abuse reporting](https://github.com/contact/report-abuse), which is handled independently of this project.

Reports are read in confidence. Because a single person maintains this repository, there is no guaranteed response time.

Enforcement is proportionate: a private correction for a first lapse, a temporary block for repetition, a permanent one for harassment or for behaviour that continues after a warning.
